name: cortico-world-fatfish
description: 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话让它帮你干活写代码，宠物回复时用内置语音包读出声。桥接这半边需要先装 DSH 的 Host 插件（coopanion-connector-dsh）才会连；不会装就看源码仓库的说明，或把仓库地址交给 AI 帮你装。/ Chat with DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so it does the work — writing code for you — and hear the pet's replies read aloud with built-in voices. The bridge half needs the DSH Host extension first; if that sounds hard, open the source repo and let an AI walk you through it.
author: blacksunshy

zh.description: 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话，让它帮你干活、写代码；宠物回复你的时候用内置语音包读出声。桥接需要先装 DSH 的 Host 插件才会连——不会装就看源码仓库说明，或把仓库地址交给 AI 帮你装。

en.description: Chat with DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so it does the work and writes code for you, and hear the pet's replies read aloud with built-in voices. The bridge needs the DSH Host extension installed first — if that sounds hard, open the source repo and let an AI walk you through it.
